note: Treg lineage stratification by Helios on Helios × Foxp3. Treg_Heliosp: stable-lineage Treg (enriched for thymus-derived Treg) — right cluster (Helios+). Treg_Heliosn: peripherally-induced or less-stable Treg — left cluster (Helios-). Helios is bimodal — boundary set at the valley between the two peaks. Foxp3 (y) is a parent-gate visual QC only (parent already Foxp3+, events stay at Foxp3-high).
tips: Treg lineage stratification by Helios (Ikaros family TF IKZF2). Treg_Heliosp: Helios+ — note that Helios as a strict thymic-origin marker is contested; Helios expression can also be induced in peripherally-generated Treg under certain activation conditions [Gottschalk et al. 2012, Akimova et al.], so 'Helios+' is best read as 'enriched for stable-lineage Treg' rather than a definitive tTreg marker. Treg_Heliosn: Helios-. The Foxp3 y-axis is a parent-gate visual QC only — parent is already Foxp3+, so all events should sit at Foxp3-high; the call is driven by Helios on x. In-panel co-marker priors: CD25 bright supports stable Treg; CD45RA+ CCR7+ (Step 11) corresponds to Miyara Fraction I-like, and Helios+ CD45RA+ corresponds to a stable Treg phenotype.
